subject: MdePkg: ArmLib: Drop DebugLib Dependency
reasons: Removes one #include <Library/DebugLib.h> from a .c file and removes a [LibraryClasses] DebugLib entry from one .inf file.
This is a targeted one-off dependency cleanup in a single library — not a systematic pattern across multiple callers.
INF file changes are not within Coccinelle's scope (it handles C code, not build descriptor files).
No repetitive transformation across multiple files.
